name: captive under floor 7
source:
The protagonist "KYU", a sharp-tongued host, and the jirai-kei crossdresser "OTOGI", who he broke up with a while ago, were stuck underneath the 7th floor of the hotel.

With this opportunity, Kyu thinks of getting to know Otogi better once more.
On the other hand, Otogi...
